<!--
Research notes, Splash Software.

Surfaced while building out Lenex. The Splash Meet Manager stub had already flagged the
company as needing untangling; this page gives the vendor somewhere to live.

What is established:
  - The four Lenex sample files on swimrankings.net (dated 1 December 2024) name the
    writing program as SPLASH Meet Manager and the provider as Splash Software GmbH of
    Spiegel bei Bern, Switzerland, with a swimrankings.net sales address. The registration
    string reads "Geologix Test User".
  - The Swimrankings wiki credits "Splash Meet and Team Manager" to Christian Kaufmann, the
    maintainer of Lenex. A LinkedIn profile lists Kaufmann as owner (Inhaber) of Splash
    Software GmbH (not independently verified).
  - Older Splash documentation hosted on the Swim Wiki (Meet_Manager_How-to-start.pdf) gives
    "Splash Software, GeoLogix AG, Berne", and says federations hold global Splash contracts
    with GeoLogix. Search summaries describe swimrankings.net as operated by GeoLogix AG.
  - SwimNews advertised "Splash Meet & Team Manager" from Oct-Nov 2001 (no. 268) through
    Nov-Dec 2002 (no. 275), at splash.swimnews.com, headed "Splash Software" from no. 272.
    Early ads offered results in Splash's own format and SDIF; from May-June 2002 the list
    added Lenex, WSV, Aquabec and Commlink. The ads claimed nine interface languages and
    timing interfaces for Omega, Daktronics, Colorado, Alge and Longines.
  - A later "SwimNews Pro-Swim Meet Manager" (pro-swim.swimnews.com, copyright 2009 Archive
    Imaging Services Ltd.) looks like a SwimNews-branded relative, but nothing states that.

Resolved in the Splash Meet Manager pass (September 2026), details in that page's comment
and in geologix.md: Splash began as Kaufmann's own business in Berne; the website moved to
splash.swimnews.com under a joint venture with SwimNews in January 2002; GeoLogix AG
(registered March 2002) took over development and support in November 2003 with Kaufmann as
shareholder; Splash Software GmbH was entered in the commercial register on 7 December 2015
(UID CHE-207.485.444, Ahornweg 41, Spiegel bei Bern, capital CHF 20,000, Kaufmann sole
manager and shareholder, per Moneyhouse). GeoLogix AG still exists with Kaufmann on its
board. The vendor now says it has built the software in Switzerland since 1988.

Still open: the terms of the SwimNews arrangement; whether GeoLogix keeps any Splash role.

Sources: swimrankings.net/files/example-*.lxf (CONSTRUCTOR element); wiki.swimrankings.net
Lenex page; wiki.swimrankings.net/images/8/83/Meet_Manager_How-to-start.pdf (via search
summary only); SwimNews 268-275; pro-swim.swimnews.com.
-->

This article is a stub. Splash Software is the Swiss publisher of
[Splash Meet Manager](../software/splash-meet-manager.md) and its team-management
counterpart, named as Splash Software GmbH of Spiegel bei Bern in files its program writes,
and its software is credited to Christian Kaufmann, who also maintains the
[Lenex](../software/lenex.md) format.

From 2003 until about 2015 the product was developed and supported by
[GeoLogix](geologix.md) of Berne, with Kaufmann as a shareholder; see the
[vendors index](index.md) for the companies this section covers.
